evidence: Adds an optional script execution tracer directly to the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper across src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{cpp,h} and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h.
rationale: Adds a script execution tracing interface to libbitcoinkernel so external consumers can implement step-by-step debuggers and visualizers. The PR description demonstrates this with a working sketch on rust-bitcoinkernel and notes utility for testing harnesses, providing clear tooling value that is reasonably deferrable.
